summary: Frontend-only verification of reverted PropertyDetailPage simpler design + KPR popup. All 10 acceptance criteria verified via Playwright on https://branding-suite-6.preview.emergentagent.com/properti/list-1.

verification_results.simpler_design: PASS - bg-slate-50 background, breadcrumb 'Kembali ke Daftar Properti' present (data-testid=prop-back-link). No 'Sehari di Rumah Ini' / 'Kalau hatimu bilang' sections found.
verification_results.gallery_with_thumbnails: PASS - 5 thumbnails rendered, clicking switches active image.
verification_results.sticky_sidebar: PASS - title, price (#0025F5), specs, WA btn (data-testid=prop-wa-btn), KPR btn (data-testid=prop-kpr-btn), Jadwalkan Survey, Dea agent card with green online dot, and 4 trust badges (Terverifikasi/Legal Aman/Bebas Sengketa/KPR Ready) all present.
verification_results.kpr_popup_no_navigation: PASS - Clicking prop-kpr-btn opens role=dialog, URL stays at /properti/list-1 (no navigation to /kpr).
verification_results.kpr_dialog_contents: PASS - 3 sliders visible (DP/Tenor/Margin; Harga is input) + estimation shown 'Rp 4.888.889', 'Ajukan KPR Sekarang' and 'Tutup' buttons present. Tutup closes dialog.
verification_results.content_order: PASS - Gallery > Tentang Properti > Spesifikasi (8 fields) > Fasilitas (6) > Lokasi.
verification_results.related_section: PASS - 'PROPERTI TERKAIT' section rendered at bottom.
verification_results.detail_navigation_from_search: PASS - /cari-properti Detail link href=/properti/list-0 and navigates correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: KPR dialog has 3 sliders + 1 numeric input for Harga (matches design). Spec said 'sliders for Harga/DP/Tenor/Margin' - Harga is an input field; if strict slider is required, main agent may want to align.
PropertyDetailPage.jsx is 450 lines - acceptable size, no split needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PropertyDetailPage revert verified. Simpler design + KPR popup on same page both work. All data-testids resolve. No further action needed on this page.
